current_source_requirement: Exact clean Git HEAD; R08 independent-authority inventory must pass; current-source focused or full pytest required for source_pass
native_requirement: Observed native Termux runtime, current-source passing tests, installed devtool --help success; local native scope only
external_evidence_policy: User JSON receipts are hashed, bounded and source-matched as untrusted observations; they never promote hosted, consumer, device, formal security or release booleans
never_infer: remote device identity from adb or operator JSON
formal H1/H2 closure from historical anchor hashes
release qualification from any R09 self-report
operations: Read-only by default. --output creates a new private JSON file only; --run-tests and --full-tests execute bounded local tests. No CI dispatch, downloads, Android mutation, or auto-recovery.
source_test_skip_policy: Required R09 focused selection must have zero skips; missing Textual or another lane blocks source_pass/native_pass.
